name: Freepik AI
tagline: Freepik has integrated powerful AI image generation directly into its platform, which already serves over 50 million designers and creatives monthly. Its AI Image Generator (powered by Mystic and Flux models), AI Photo Editor, and Pikaso real-time sketch-to-image tool let users generate and edit images without leaving the Freepik workflow. Because it's embedded in a platform where users already source stock imagery, AI generation has seen rapid adoption — over 100 million AI images generated in its first year.
